name: FirstUK Bank — Branch Operations Training Manual
description: The primary training manual for branch staff, managers, and tellers covering operational procedures within the retail banking department.
context: FirstUK Bank — Branch Operations Training Manual

name: Branch Operations and Management Training
description: A training program designed to instruct branch staff on the essential requirements of daily operations, customer service excellence, and the standards for opening procedures and general branch management.
context: Train branch staff on daily operations, customer service, opening procedures, and branch management standards.

name: Physical Security Opening Check
description: A mandatory set of security checks that must be performed 30 minutes before the branch opens to ensure the premises are secure.
context: Check for any signs of break-in

name: Cash Vault Verification and Loading
description: The required process for counting vault cash, verifying it against reports, and distributing standard amounts to teller drawers.
context: Count cash in vault (report to manager)
Load cash drawers for tellers (standard: £5,000 per drawer)

name: System Startup and Access Verification
description: The operational requirement to boot systems, verify the status dashboard, and ensure teller access to customer accounts is functional.
context: Log into teller systems with credentials
Verify ability to access customer accounts

name: Branch Readiness and Staffing Check
description: The obligation to ensure the physical environment is clean and professional and that staff are present by the designated time.
context: Confirm staff are at their desks by 08:50 AM

name: Customer Accounts
description: Customer accounts that tellers must be able to access as part of the system startup and readiness process.
context: Verify ability to access customer accounts

name: Customer Greeting Standard
description: A service level requirement ensuring customers are acknowledged promptly upon arrival during business hours.

name: Transaction Accuracy Requirement
description: An operational obligation requiring staff to process financial transactions without errors.

name: New Account KYC/AML Procedure Compliance
description: A regulatory obligation requiring staff to apply Know Your Customer and Anti-Money Laundering checks when opening new accounts.
context: Follow KYC/AML procedures for new accounts

name: Cash Drawer Security Maintenance
description: A security obligation to ensure the physical and procedural safety of cash drawers at teller stations.

name: Customer Queue Monitoring and Backup Trigger
description: An operational requirement to monitor the customer queue and trigger backup staffing when the queue exceeds 10 people.
context: Customer queue monitored (>10 people = call backup)

name: Teller Station Staffing Requirement
description: An operational obligation to ensure all teller stations are staffed during business hours.

name: Cash Drawer Balance Monitoring
description: A financial control requirement to regularly monitor the balances of cash drawers.

name: System Performance Monitoring
description: A technical obligation to ensure banking systems are running smoothly during operational hours.

name: Customer Complaint Resolution
description: A service obligation to ensure no customer complaints remain pending.

name: Customer
description: Individuals interacting with the bank at teller stations or within the branch queue.

name: New Account
description: Accounts being opened by customers, which trigger mandatory KYC and AML procedures.
context: Follow KYC/AML procedures for new accounts

name: Teller Transaction
description: Financial transactions handled by staff at teller stations that must be processed accurately.

name: Transaction Cut-off Obligation
description: A strict operational requirement to cease the initiation of new customer transactions before the branch closes.
context: Do not start new transactions after 16:55 PM

name: Cash Verification and Vault Security Obligation
description: The requirement to collect, verify, and secure all teller cash in the vault, ensuring counts match previous records.
context: Collect cash from all teller drawers
Count and verify (must match previous count)

name: High-Value Night Deposit Obligation
description: A specific requirement to count and seal cash for night deposit when the amount exceeds £10,000.
context: Count and seal cash for night deposit (if >£10,000)

name: System Security and Data Protection Obligation
description: The duty to log out of systems, ensure no transactions are pending, and verify that no sensitive customer data remains visible on screens.
context: Log out of all customer systems
Verify no sensitive data on screens

name: Physical Security and Document Disposal Obligation
description: The requirement to secure customer files, shred waste, lock all doors, and arm the alarm system.

name: Closure Documentation Obligation
description: The requirement to record the exact time of closure and the names of the staff members present.
context: Record closure time and staff names

name: Managerial Sign-Off Obligation
description: The final verification step where a manager must confirm the branch is closed and cash is reconciled.
context: Manager Sign-Off: Verify branch closed properly and all cash reconciled

name: Security Code Placeholder
description: A dynamic placeholder for the specific alarm system security code used during the physical closure process.

name: Closing Announcement Script
description: A short, standardized verbal announcement to inform customers of the imminent branch closure.

name: Part 2 — Customer Service Standards
description: A training section focused on the standards of customer interaction and service delivery at FirstUK Bank, specifically covering the initial greeting process.

name: Standardised Customer Greeting Procedure
description: Staff must be able to execute the correct greeting sequence upon a customer's arrival, including timing, verbal phrasing, and non-verbal cues.
context: Greet within 2 minutes: "Good morning/afternoon, welcome to FirstUK Bank"

name: Customer Greeting Time Limit
description: Staff are required to greet customers within a specific timeframe of two minutes upon their arrival at the bank.

name: Customer Mood Assessment
description: Staff must observe and note the emotional state of the customer (e.g., whether they are upset or have an urgent need) during the initial interaction.

name: Bank Customer
description: The individual visiting the bank branch who is the recipient of the customer service standards and greeting procedures.

name: Waiting Customer Management Script
description: A set of scripted responses and actions for staff to manage customers experiencing delays in a physical or virtual queue. The template provides specific phrasing based on the duration of the wait time.
context: If Wait > 5 Minutes: Apologize: "Sorry for the wait, we'll be with you shortly"
Offer refreshment: "Can I get you a coffee or water?"
If Wait > 15 Minutes: Escalate to manager

name: Waiting Customer
description: A customer who is currently waiting for service and is the recipient of the waiting management communication scripts.
context: Offer refreshment: "Can I get you a coffee or water?"

name: Manager Escalation Duty for Extended Wait
description: A mandatory operational requirement to escalate the situation to a manager when a customer's wait time exceeds 15 minutes.
context: If Wait > 15 Minutes: Escalate to manager

name: Handling Difficult Customers Training
description: A training unit focused on managing interactions with angry customers and identifying specific triggers that require the escalation of a situation to management.

name: De-escalation of Angry Customers
description: The ability to manage an angry customer through active listening, emotional acknowledgement, apology, and clear communication of next steps.
context: Acknowledge their emotion: "I understand you're frustrated"
Apologize: "I'm sorry we let you down"
Explain next steps: "Here's what we'll do..."

name: Customer Voice Elevation or Profanity
description: A behavioral indicator where the customer becomes verbally aggressive, triggering an immediate escalation process.
context: Customer raises voice or uses profanity

name: High Value Complaint (>£1,000)
description: A financial threshold trigger where any complaint involving an amount greater than £1,000 requires management intervention.

name: Explicit Request for Management
description: A direct request from the customer to speak with a manager, serving as a trigger for escalation.

name: Regulatory or Compliance Issue
description: A scenario where the customer's complaint involves a potential breach of regulatory or compliance standards.

name: Potential Fraud Indicator
description: The identification of signs suggesting that a customer interaction or transaction may be fraudulent.

name: Immediate Escalation and Transaction Halt
description: A mandatory requirement for staff to stop any current transaction and contact a manager immediately upon the occurrence of an escalation trigger.
context: Action: Stop transaction, call manager immediately

name: Angry Customer
description: A customer exhibiting frustration or anger who requires specific de-escalation techniques and potential management intervention.

name: Escalated Transaction
description: A financial transaction that must be halted due to the presence of escalation triggers such as potential fraud or high-value complaints.

name: PART 3: Account Opening in Branch
description: A comprehensive training unit detailing the end-to-end 45-minute process for opening a new bank account within a branch setting, covering discovery through to account closure.

name: KYC Verification Process
description: The identity and address verification stage of account opening, requiring the examination and filing of government-issued photo ID and proof of residency.
context: Request photo ID (UK Passport or Driving License)
Request proof of address (utility bill, council tax, bank statement)

name: AML Screening Process
description: The mandatory anti-money laundering check where customers are screened against international sanctions lists including OFAC, EU, and HMT.

name: ID Validity and Tampering Check
description: Staff are required to physically examine original identification documents to ensure they are valid and have not been tampered with.

name: KYC Document Filing Requirement
description: A mandatory requirement to create photocopies of both the photo ID and proof of address and store them in the customer file.

name: Mandatory Sanctions Screening
description: The obligation to run every new customer through the OFAC, EU, and HMT screening lists during the account opening process.

name: AML Hit Escalation Duty
description: The requirement to immediately escalate the application to the Compliance department if the AML screening returns a 'hit'.

name: AML Result Documentation
description: The requirement to formally record the outcome of the AML screening process.

name: Branch Customer
description: The individual visiting the branch to open a new account, subject to discovery, KYC, and AML processes.

name: New Customer Account
description: The financial account created in the system following successful KYC and AML verification.

name: Debit Card
description: The payment card offered to the customer during the account creation process, including a specific application and security briefing.

name: Savings Account
description: A banking product identified during the discovery phase to meet the customer's specific financial needs.

name: Checking Account
description: A banking product identified during the discovery phase to meet the customer's specific financial needs.

name: ID Type
description: A placeholder used in the KYC record to specify the type of identification document verified (e.g., Passport).

name: Document Number
description: A placeholder used in the KYC record to capture the unique identification number of the verified document.

name: Part 4 — Common Branch Transactions
description: A training section focusing on the standard operational procedures for handling routine transactions within a bank branch, specifically detailing the cash deposit process.

name: Cash Deposit Process Execution
description: The ability for staff to correctly execute the six-step sequence for processing a customer cash deposit, from account verification to closing the transaction.
context: Count cash in front of customer

name: Cash Deposit Exceeding £1,000 (Suspicious Activity)
description: A red flag triggered when a customer deposits more than £1,000 in cash, which is categorized as suspicious activity requiring further compliance action.

name: Currency Transaction Report (CTR) Filing Obligation
description: The mandatory requirement for staff to file a Currency Transaction Report (CTR) and consult compliance when a cash deposit exceeds the £1,000 threshold.

name: Branch Customer
description: The individual visiting the branch to perform a cash deposit transaction.
context: Count cash in front of customer

name: Customer Deposit Account
description: The specific account being credited during the cash deposit process.

name: Cash Deposit Transaction
description: The financial event of depositing cash into an account, specifically noted for monitoring when it exceeds £1,000.

name: Customer Identity Verification Requirement
description: Staff are required to verify the identity of the customer before proceeding with a cash withdrawal using either an account card or a valid ID.
context: Verify customer identity (account card or ID)

name: Cash Withdrawal Limit Approval Process
description: Withdrawals exceeding £5,000 are prohibited without obtaining manager approval and ensuring prior notice has been given.
context: Withdrawal limit: £5,000 max (above requires manager approval + notice)

name: Cash Withdrawal Exceeding £1,000 (Suspicious Activity)
description: A cash withdrawal of more than £1,000 is flagged as suspicious activity requiring a Currency Transaction Report (CTR).

name: Currency Transaction Report (CTR) Filing Obligation
description: Staff must file a Currency Transaction Report (CTR) and consult compliance when a withdrawal exceeds £1,000.
context: Suspicious Activity: >£1,000 withdrawal (file CTR, see compliance)

name: Cash Withdrawal Customer
description: The customer performing a cash withdrawal transaction who must undergo identity verification.
context: Verify customer identity (account card or ID)

name: Withdrawal Account
description: The account from which funds are being withdrawn, which must be verified for sufficient balance.

name: Cash Withdrawal Transaction
description: The financial event of withdrawing cash, subject to specific limits and reporting thresholds.

name: Account Card
description: A card used as a means of verifying the customer's identity during the withdrawal process.
context: Verify customer identity (account card or ID)

name: Customer Identity Verification for Account Closure
description: A mandatory step in the account closure process requiring staff to verify the identity of the customer before proceeding with the closure.

name: Confirmation of Account Closure Request
description: Staff must explicitly confirm the customer's request to close the account as part of the standard closure procedure.

name: Final Balance Calculation
description: The requirement to calculate the final account balance, ensuring all pending interest and fees are accounted for prior to closure.

name: Final Statement Issuance
description: The obligation to print and provide a final statement to the customer during the account closure process.

name: Payout Method Arrangement
description: Staff must arrange a method for the customer to receive their remaining funds, with options including transfer, cheque, or cash.

name: System Account Deactivation
description: The requirement to formally deactivate the customer's account within the bank's internal systems.

name: Provision of Closure Receipt
description: The final step in the closure process where staff must provide the customer with a receipt confirming the account has been closed.

name: Account for Closure
description: A customer account that is undergoing the formal closure process as described in the training manual.

name: Customer Requesting Closure
description: The bank customer who is initiating the request to close their account and whose identity must be verified.

name: Standing Order Setup Training
description: A procedural training unit detailing the step-by-step process for staff to set up a standing order for a customer. It covers the collection of recipient data, payment terms, and the final confirmation steps.
context: Obtain recipient details (name, account number, sort code)

name: Standing Order Setup Process Execution
description: The ability for staff to correctly execute the six-step sequence required to establish a standing order, from obtaining recipient details to providing a receipt.
context: Obtain recipient details (name, account number, sort code)

name: Recipient Detail Collection Obligation
description: Staff are required to obtain specific recipient identification data, including name, account number, and sort code, before proceeding with a standing order setup.
context: Obtain recipient details (name, account number, sort code)

name: Payment Terms Confirmation Obligation
description: Staff must confirm the specific payment amount, the frequency of the payments, and the start date with the customer.

name: Standing Order Receipt Provision Obligation
description: Staff must generate a confirmation and provide a receipt to the customer upon completion of the standing order setup.

name: Recipient Account
description: The destination account for the standing order, identified by an account number and sort code.
context: Obtain recipient details (name, account number, sort code)

name: Standing Order Transaction
description: A recurring financial transfer characterized by a specific amount, frequency, and start date.

name: Direct Debit Mandate Collection Process
description: A mandatory sequence of steps staff must follow to ensure the correct collection and processing of Direct Debit mandates, including verification and secure filing.

name: Biller Notification Obligation
description: The requirement to notify the biller upon receipt of a Direct Debit mandate, which is handled via an automated process.

name: Customer Copy Provision
description: The obligation to provide the customer with a copy of the Direct Debit mandate form.

name: Direct Debit Account
description: The customer account associated with the Direct Debit mandate that requires detail verification.

name: Direct Debit Customer
description: The customer providing the signed mandate and receiving a copy of the documentation.

name: Part 5 — Security Procedures
description: A training section focused on the physical and operational security of cash handling, including vault access, teller drawer management, and thresholds for large transactions.

name: Vault Two-Person Rule
description: A mandatory security requirement ensuring that vault access is never performed by a single individual, requiring both a manager and a teller.

name: Vault Attendance Requirement
description: A strict prohibition against leaving the bank vault open without supervision.

name: Secure Cash Counting Protocol
description: Requirement to count cash on a designated secure counter rather than a standard desk to maintain security.
context: Count cash on secure counter (not desk)

name: Teller Drawer Security and Reporting
description: Obligation to keep teller drawers locked during absence, perform daily counts, and immediately report any financial discrepancies.

name: Manager Approval for Large Transactions
description: Requirement for manager authorization for any deposit or withdrawal exceeding £1,000.

name: CTR Filing Obligation
description: Mandatory filing of a Currency Transaction Report (CTR) form for deposits or withdrawals exceeding £5,000.

name: Internal Controls Check for High-Value Transactions
description: Requirement to perform an internal controls check for any transaction exceeding £10,000.

name: Large Deposit/Withdrawal Transaction
description: Financial events involving high-value cash movements that trigger specific approval and reporting obligations.

name: Confidentiality of Customer Personal Information
description: A set of mandatory rules regarding the handling and discussion of customer personal information to ensure data security. Staff are prohibited from discussing sensitive data in public areas and must secure physical documents.
context: Never discuss on phone where customers can hear
File customer documents in locked cabinet
Shred documents when no longer needed

name: Secure System Access Protocol
description: Mandatory security requirements for staff accessing bank systems. This includes strict rules on password sharing, session management, and workstation security.

name: Immediate Reporting of Suspicious Activity
description: A mandatory requirement for staff to notify the bank immediately upon detecting any suspicious activity related to system access or security.

name: Bank Customer
description: The individual whose personal information must be protected and kept confidential by bank staff.
context: Never discuss on phone where customers can hear
File customer documents in locked cabinet

name: Customer unusually nervous/evasive (Fraud Red Flag)
description: A behavioral indicator where a customer exhibits unusual nervousness or evasiveness during interactions, signaling potential fraudulent activity.

name: Requesting large unusual transaction (Fraud Red Flag)
description: A scenario where a customer requests a transaction that is atypically large or unusual for their profile.

name: Using multiple accounts for same purpose (Fraud Red Flag)
description: A pattern where a customer utilizes several different accounts to achieve a single objective, which may indicate layering or fraud.
context: Using multiple accounts for same purpose

name: Inconsistent personal information (Fraud Red Flag)
description: A red flag triggered when the personal information provided by a customer is contradictory or inconsistent.

name: Third party insisting customer transfer funds (Fraud Red Flag)
description: A high-risk scenario where an external third party is pressuring a customer to move funds, often indicative of a scam or social engineering.
context: Third party insisting customer transfer funds

name: Escalation of Fraud Concerns
description: The mandatory requirement for staff to escalate concerns to a manager or the compliance department when fraud red flags are identified.

name: Physical Accessibility Provisioning
description: The requirement to ensure bank premises are equipped with specific accessibility features to support inclusive customer service. This includes physical infrastructure for mobility, hearing, and visual impairments, as well as privacy needs.
context: Hearing loop: Available at teller counter
Quiet area: Private space for sensitive discussions

name: Wheelchair Access Requirement
description: The obligation to provide physical access for wheelchair users through the provision of ramps and accessible toilets.

name: Hearing Loop Provision
description: The requirement to have a hearing loop available at the teller counter to assist customers with hearing impairments.
context: Hearing loop: Available at teller counter

name: Large Print Documentation Provision
description: The obligation to make forms and information available in large print for visually impaired customers.

name: Quiet Area Provision
description: The requirement to provide a private quiet area for customers who need to conduct sensitive discussions.
context: Quiet area: Private space for sensitive discussions

name: Customer with Accessibility Needs
description: Customers requiring specific physical or sensory accommodations to access banking services, including those using wheelchairs, hearing loops, or large print materials.

name: Clear and Accessible Customer Communication Obligation
description: A set of mandatory communication standards for staff when interacting with customers to ensure clarity and accessibility. This includes specific requirements for vulnerable customers and the avoidance of technical jargon.
context: Allow extra time for older/vulnerable customers

name: Vulnerable Customer
description: Customers who may require additional support or adjustments during communication, specifically including older individuals.
context: Allow extra time for older/vulnerable customers

name: Elderly or Mentally Incapacitated Customers
description: Customers who may have cognitive impairments or age-related vulnerabilities requiring staff to adjust their communication pace and patience.
context: Elderly or mentally incapacitated: Slow down, be patient

name: Customers with Language Barriers
description: Customers who cannot communicate effectively in the primary language of the bank, requiring the arrangement of an interpreter.

name: Abuse Victims
description: Customers experiencing abuse who require a safe environment and confidential assistance from bank staff.
context: Abuse victims: Offer safe space, confidential help

name: Victims of Financial Abuse
description: Customers who are being subjected to financial exploitation, triggering a mandatory escalation to the compliance department.

name: Provision of Safe Space and Confidential Help for Abuse Victims
description: The requirement for staff to provide a secure environment and confidential support when dealing with customers who are victims of abuse.
context: Abuse victims: Offer safe space, confidential help

name: Escalation of Financial Abuse to Compliance
description: The mandatory requirement to report and escalate suspected cases of financial abuse to the bank's compliance department.

name: Indicators of Financial Abuse
description: Signs or scenarios suggesting a customer is a victim of financial abuse, which necessitates immediate escalation.

name: KYC Completion Requirement
description: A performance standard requiring that 100% of Know Your Customer (KYC) processes are completed accurately.

name: AML Screening Requirement
description: A mandatory performance standard ensuring that 100% of required Anti-Money Laundering (AML) screenings are performed.

name: Fraud and Security Incident Reporting Timeline
description: A security obligation requiring that all fraud or security incidents be reported within a 24-hour window.

name: Immediate Customer Data Breach Reporting
description: A critical security obligation requiring the immediate reporting of any breaches involving customer data.

name: Suspicious Transaction Reporting Obligation
description: A strict compliance requirement that 100% of all identified suspicious transactions must be reported.

name: Vault Discrepancy Zero Tolerance
description: A security standard establishing a zero-tolerance policy for any discrepancies found within the bank vault.

name: Escalation of Customer Disputes exceeding £1,000
description: A mandatory requirement to escalate customer disputes that exceed the value of £1,000 to the Area Manager.

name: Escalation of Fraud and AML Concerns
description: A mandatory requirement to report any concerns regarding Fraud or Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to the Compliance department.

name: Escalation of Security Breaches
description: A mandatory requirement to report security breaches to the Security department.

name: Escalation of Technical Problems
description: The requirement to contact the IT Help Desk when encountering technical problems.
context: Technical problem | IT Help Desk | ext. 5000

name: Mandatory Branch Staff Onboarding Training
description: A mandatory training program that all branch staff must complete prior to commencing their roles. It serves as the foundational requirement for staff entry.
context: Mandatory Training: All branch staff before starting

name: Mandatory Training Completion for Branch Staff
description: The requirement that all branch staff must complete the mandatory training before they are permitted to start their duties.
context: Mandatory Training: All branch staff before starting

name: Annual Training Refresher Requirement
description: The obligation for staff to undergo training refreshers on an annual basis or whenever there are changes to operational procedures.
context: Refresher: Annually or when procedures change

name: Manager Certification Requirement
description: A mandatory certification process that must be completed by individuals before they are eligible to manage a branch.
context: Manager Certification: Must complete before managing branch
